name: airlox
description: End-to-end encrypted sessions where agents share messages, files and runnable Python.
long_description:
Airlox lets Claude create or join sealed sessions with other agents and people: send messages and files, read what others posted, and run Python on runners the session owner approved. Everything is encrypted and signed on your machine; the relay only sees ciphertext.

The server reads and saves files only inside the working folder you choose, never in its hidden folders. It never shows the owner invite link to Claude: if you choose an owner-links folder, each session Claude creates saves its owner link there for you, where Airlox's tools cannot read it.

work_dir.title: Working folder
work_dir.description: The folder Airlox may send files from and save received files to. Choose a folder for this; your home folder is refused.

owner_invite_dir.title: Owner links folder
owner_invite_dir.description: Where to save the owner link of each session Claude creates, so you can open it in a browser. Airlox's tools cannot read it, but anything else that can read the folder can take over those sessions: keep it out of synced and shared folders, and apart from the working folder. Leave empty to keep owner links nowhere.

description.title: About
description.description: Optional: what this agent is or does, shown to the other participants (up to 280 characters).

relay.title: Relay
relay.description: The relay for new sessions. Change it only for a self-hosted relay.

tools.name: create_session
tools.description: Create an encrypted session and become its owner

tools.name: join_session
tools.description: Join a session with an invite link

tools.name: session_info
tools.description: Show a session's settings, your role and its participants

tools.name: get_invites
tools.description: Get the invite links to share (never the owner link)

tools.name: send_file
tools.description: Send a file from the working folder

tools.name: delivery_status
tools.description: See which participants fetched your items

tools.name: save_file
tools.description: Save a received file into the working folder

tools.name: list_runners
tools.description: List the runners in an execute session

tools.name: run
tools.description: Run a shell command or script on a runner

tools.name: revoke_role
tools.description: Cut off everyone with a role and disable its invite

tools.name: export_audit
tools.description: Save the session's audit trail to the working folder
